rejected_findings.title: Stage-2 per-sender stamp omits stage-1's applied-sender guard; APPLIED_SINCE_LOAD untested
rejected_findings.reason: False positive. The applied-sender exclusion lives in the view inbound_email_sender_state (supabase/migrations/20260731213000_add_inbound_email_sender_state_view.sql:38-40: 'AND lower(ie.sender_email) NOT IN (SELECT lower(email) FROM application a WHERE a.vacancy_id = ie.vacancy_id)'), the single home of the rule — both bulk and per-applicant stage-2 SQL consume stage2_due from it, so an applied sender has no view row and can never be stamped. mark_followup_for_sender.sql's own header comment states the view 'is the single home of the rule'. The per-applicant SQL is character-identical in structure to the bulk mark_followup_reminders_for_vacancy.sql (verified). Applied-exclusion is pinned at the bulk level by followup_excludes_applied_enquirers_test (awaiting_integration_test.gleam:431) and shared transitively; the blind lens had no access to the view (predates the PR).
